scope: Static name/address registry. Direct service-record to native C-closure bridge is documented in native-binding-abi.json. No engine implementation or runtime parity is implied; callback addresses require initialized native engine state and are reference metadata only.

QUEST.namespace_association: Namespace-name getter and method initializer share the observed owner vtable layout. Generic service-record to C-closure dispatch is traced; full per-namespace bootstrap/runtime installation remains unobserved.
QUEST.mapping_status: observed descriptor name and callback store paired by normalized stack offset
